No source edits; all fixes routed to coordinator/original owners, and a raced model-options inference was explicitly corrected rather than counted as runtime evidence. messages.subject: Initial required checks and G6 diagnostic semantics
messages.body: Required check_repo.py PASS; first full pytest during concurrent model edits:262 passed,3 failed,1 warning/24.72s (fixed-window configs/tests mismatch and planar_control default depth kernel). Not a final snapshot; will rerun after owner-ready. Additional G6 semantic concern: set_frozen_intervention only changes requires_grad/detach, so frozen-checkpoint logits are identical and it is not a branch-reliance intervention; Hybrid calls self.skip(d,detail) while native d and detail remain live bypasses, so skip_stopgrad only blocks the extra residual input, not the named native skip. Owner should define scope accurately and provide operational inference branch perturbation/ablation + retraining gradient tests if claiming full G6.

messages.subject: model fixes implemented
messages.body: Patched fusion/models: zero-init now zeros only terminal residual projections (CrossZ planar and SkipFusion), upstream random survives; added 2-SGD input-dependence tests and exact zero parity. Hybrid defaults fixed window but respects explicit none future controls; architecture widths are four-stage and meaningful on tiny synthetic, CNN stage widths honored, hybrid z_kernels depth honored and non-unit z_strides rejected, CNN non-neutral skip/depth rejected. Owned tests currently 20 passed; config tests await tooling owner widths/window updates.

messages.subject: remaining ignored fields
messages.body: I also see volume25d currently silently ignores z_kernels/z_strides and residual_init; CNN3D silently ignores residual_init. I'll add architecture-specific neutral-value rejection for these fields unless you prefer config schema updates. Current primary config files still contain z fields/defaults; tooling owner should remove or set neutral explicitly.

messages.subject: AMP fail-closed and large-volume FP16 reduction
messages.body: Independent manufactured precision probe: VolumeTrainer(Toy CPU, precision=amp) accepts and silently uses nullcontext/scalerNone (FP32), rather than fail closed. logits float16 shape1,4,4,128,128 and labels allclass1 produce NaN in both loss modes at65536voxels; manual Dice numerator/denominator reduce in logits dtype and overflow even if CUDA autocast upcasts CE. No GPU run claimed: fix loss reductions/probabilities to stable FP32 under low precision and add large-support finite gradient numerical test; reject unsupported device precision explicitly. Also required reporting fields currently teacher_student_disagreement=NaN, no per-class acceptance, no actual parameter update norms propagated from safe_optimizer_step.

messages.subject: neutral z controls now enforced
messages.body: Added reject/neutral checks: volume25d rejects non-(1,3,3) z_kernels and non-(1,1,1) z_strides, CNN3D rejects non-neutral residual_init; controls no longer silently ignored. default_volume_config currently uses volume25d z_strides [[1,2,2]], so config owner must update default/volume25d recipes or tests will fail.

Thus earlier smokes cannot certify current registry after model rewrite. Please ensure model/tooling owners align schemas before ready signal; I will rerun bounded CLI export/eval after that.
